title: Grayslake Heritage Center

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Free Daily Admission To encourage practice, all swim lesson participants receive FREE DAILY ADMISSION on the day of their lesson! Programs for Kids of All Ages The Grayslake Aquatic Center offers a unique swim lesson program designed to teach children of all ages and abilities to swim. The swim lesson program is designed to progress from fundamental water skills to beginning and advanced swimming strokes. Each class / level focuses on the introduction, development, and mastery of a particular skill set to prepare children for the next class / level. A variety of instruction options (group, small group, individual) allows parents to choose the best learning environment for their child.

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Grayslake Heritage Center & Museum campus includes an 11,000 square foot facility housing multiple galleries, archives, a community room, dedicated classroom space, a museum store and collections storage. The facility is handicapped accessible. Parking is available on the north and east sides of the building, with additional spaces on nearby Whitney Street. services.name: Bike Trails
services.desc: In 1989 Grayslake became one of the first communities in the region to include the development of a comprehensive town-wide trail system in its planning. Since 1989, the bike path/trails have developed into a 21-mile system connecting all areas of the Village. While some other communities have trail systems, Grayslake’s bike trails are an integral part of our community’s neighborhoods, parks, and Village Center, thereby providing an alternative to auto-use creating sustainability benefits locally.
